title: Wingthing: finish bare-wt guided onboarding and route clarity
description:
## Source:

Bryan verbatim: 'wt default tui should help you install some default agents if you don't already have one' / 'It should help you understand that you're a local only connection and potentially try to upsell to pro at a later date' / 'That wingthing wt tui is the main entrypoint'.

Binding spec: /work/lanes/skeptic/inputs/mac/drive/wingthing-app-spec.md and /work/lanes/wt-app/PRD.md. Original item/comments: /work/lanes/refine-wingthing/evidence/fleet-kxez.show.json and .comments.json.

Card: 01/card-1, ordinal #2: 2 · An empty navigator is a useful beginning
Source: /work/lanes/wt-e2e/wingthing/evidence/storyboard-source/01-install.html#2
Carrier: f8f9ebd96e1c72336ffd796c8d496ecda0a85619; Linux forge; isolated HOME/WINGTHING_DIR; fixture provider/SSH, real built wt + kernel PTY.

Expected screen: Empty navigator, connection header, wing/roost explanation and useful keys
Expected observable state: Zero sessions and no account, provider or daemon started

Actual outcome across three runs: FAIL, FAIL, FAIL.


## Why

Bryan and first-time developers can install an agent, understand the connection and start useful work.

## The one question / capability

Can a new developer reach a useful first session from bare wt with informed consent?

## Scope

Repo: ehrlich-b/wingthing. Base: codex/wt-integration-20261011 @ 3a0b7fa8578b9889d9e17a0e5fb3a1ffab9831ca. Branch: codex/refine-fleet-kxez-20261011; isolated checkout, record actual head and binary hash. cmd/wt/main.go, internal/dashboard/actions.go and render.go, new internal/dashboard/onboarding*.go, a cmd/wt installer adapter (new), docs/INSTALL-SOURCES.md, and docs/product/onboarding.md. Continue the undelivered product scope of closed fleet-7zpb; its 73cd2c1 handoff was blocked and implemented no product. This live owner consolidates flow-01 cards 1,4,5,6,7. Coordinator serializes root CLI/dashboard registration and any storyboard edits.

## Non-goals

No duplicate source-DONE implementation, Linux confinement bypass, public release/deploy, account/payment/provider spend or external outreach. Bare wt stays primary; free SSH/LAN/tailnet stay available and automatic Pro offers default OFF. Use disposable fixture sessions and installer transports; actual user/native/physical acceptance remains separately evidenced.

## Acceptance

Local PATH-only detection shows installed agents with nonblocking Add more, or a no-agent chooser with Skip. Empty view states wing/roost meaning and the actual selected route; Mac local header says "Local only: this Mac + phones paired on your network"; Linux copy names this machine accurately. ? explains free local/saved SSH/LAN/tailnet, paid relay/cloud and external inference/installer traffic. Before any installer is executed, show exact selected official per-platform command and machine, verify vendor documentation when implementing, and record sources/date in INSTALL-SOURCES.md. Enter explicitly consents; Escape runs nothing. Verify executable/version, hand off to the provider native login, then require actual admission/readiness and preserve original ID before first attach/detach/reattach. Failed install/PATH/login shows the failed stage, rescan/Back and a fresh-consent retry; no sudo, silent retry or fake readiness. Startup/detection execute zero network calls or provider/installer launches. Separate marketing flag defaults OFF: zero automatic prompts in phone/publish/cloud/share; ON is dismissible once per moment, never blocks and preserves drafts/free alternatives. Enumerate and execute TestStoryboardInstallCard1,4,5,6,7 individually three times using real built wt, isolated task home/state and fake installer/login; missing/skip/no-match fails. Add flag-OFF/ON and route-change assertions; go vet ./... and full go test ./... compare to pinned baseline with no new failures. Real vendor installation/login and Mac/provider receipts remain REQUIRED-UNRUN until supplied. Merged source-card obligations (original transcripts retained in evidence/<id>.show.json):

fleet-fniu (TestStoryboardInstallCard7): Failed install/PATH/auth stage with fresh-consent retry, rescan and Back
Expected observable state: Preserve selected provider and any admitted ID; no silent retry or policy change

fleet-d0ob (TestStoryboardInstallCard6): Verify selected provider then native authentication handoff
Expected observable state: Version check is not session readiness; explicit admission ID required before attach/detach/reattach

fleet-9th4 (TestStoryboardInstallCard5): Exact selected vendor installer, machine, consent and Escape
Expected observable state: Cancel leaves agent selection and local inventory unchanged; no installer execution

fleet-38ib (TestStoryboardInstallCard4): Local agent detection and no-agent chooser/skip
Expected observable state: PATH-only inspection; no provider, installer or account operation
 MOCKS-FIRST: proposed happy/failure screenshots must receive builder self-review and separate product-review PASS against each named view question before UI implementation; revise and re-review failed mocks, then review actual screenshots/transcripts after build.

## UI contract / MOCKS-FIRST gate

User: Bryan and first-time developers can install an agent, understand the connection and start useful work. One question per view: Empty navigator: what is this connection and where do I begin? Agent picker: which agents can I use? Install consent: what exact command and machine am I approving? Verification/login: what step is needed before useful work? Recovery: which stage failed and what can I do next? Reference: /work/lanes/wt-app/storyboard (flow matching source card), existing dense keyboard navigator and docs/pairing/STORYBOARD.html. Before UI build, capture happy/failure mock screens at narrow/wide sizes with readable focus/status, then self-review and obtain independent product-review PASS. Revise failures before building; review actual screenshots/transcripts again after build.

## Review loop

Builder reviews every diff/card expectation against the one question and clear/purposeful/testable/minimal/deduplicated/no-one-shot rubric. Independent gpt-6.1-sol high implementation/evidence review before handoff; security reviewer checks policy, cursor or route authority changes. Fix findings and re-review. Product mocks must pass before UI work; coordinator integrates shared files serially.

## Dependencies

Blocking IDs: fleet-jugv. Tracking parent is not a blocker. Preserve native/physical gates and current active owner; do not create another suite lane.

## V/C

V=10/10; C=10 remaining agent-hours including implementation/qualification and review, excluding human wait. Rationale: Bryan and first-time developers can install an agent, understand the connection and start useful work. Original V/C=6/1.3 uses board scheduling units, retained in evidence rather than compared as hours.

close_reason: BRIEF.md scoped storyboard flow-01 acceptance: cards 01/card-1,4,5,6,7 now PASS in all three complete unchanged storyboard runs. Product commit 6a08b45 on codex/wt-fix-1-20261011 in /work/lanes/wt-fix-1/wingthing. Evidence: evidence/fix-1/summary.json and run-1/run-2/run-3/cards/TestStoryboardInstallCard{1,4,5,6,7}.txt, with real PTY checkpoints/raw ANSI. Full suite each run 22 PASS / 29 FAIL (baseline 17/34), no regressions or subtest flakiness; go vet ./..., dashboard package and focused Claude/dashboard CLI tests pass. Four matching card beads were already MERGE-closed into this owner. No real vendor auth/readiness or native Mac acceptance claimed; those remain REQUIRED-UNRUN, and expanded marketing obligations outside the supplied flows-1-2 brief are not acceptance evidence from this lane.
